notes.title: Neko Hacker+ is coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are releasing a new 18+ anime-style game this fall! Have a look
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677180/

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist! Thanks for your time!

notes.title: New patch is out!
notes.content:
- Added support for Windows x32 Bit
- Fixed game UI for the wide monitors (2560x1080 etc)
- Added text warning that you have to play online to get exp

notes.title: Summer update!
notes.content:
Hello!

There are summer update where you can find updated story of the main characters and new balance of the gameplay.
We've also improved stability of the game and matchmaking!

Enjoy!
